response.sql: SELECT AVG("invoice"."total") AS "average_invoice_amount" FROM "public"."invoice" INNER JOIN "public"."customer" ON "invoice"."customer_id" = "customer"."customer_id" WHERE "customer"."country" = 'USA' AND "invoice"."invoice_date" >= '2024-01-01' AND "invoice"."invoice_date" < '2025-01-01'

evidences.text:
平均每张发票金额
本项目将客单价主口径写全为平均每张发票金额，表达式 AVG(invoice.total)，每张发票权重相同。
平均每位购买客户金额另命名为 SUM(invoice.total) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice.customer_id)，不与每张发票平均金额混用。无发票或零分母时保留 NULL。
